features.title: EDR Phase 1 -- ECMLink datastream feasibility spike (knock reachability)
features.description: HARDWARE-INDEPENDENT EDR foundation (Atlas 2026-06-16 brief, phase 1). Spike: determine whether knock -- the #1 engine-killer signal -- is reachable from the ECMLink datastream over the existing ECU/OBD path, and what else ECMLink exposes beyond OBD Mode 03/07. Gates whether knock-based event triggers are even possible; shapes everything downstream, so do it early. Owners: Spool (engine/PID) + CIO (ECMLink hardware); Atlas rules the feasibility outcome before architecture commits (open gate #3). Context: MEMORY -- Mode 22 enhanced not implemented; ECMLink USB+PC is currently the only knock-retard path; ECMLink V3 owned, not yet installed (planned summer 2026). GROOM-READY candidate (hardware-independent).

features.title: EDR Phase 2 -- dedicated-reader + bus-contract design (full; A-4 versioned)
features.description: HARDWARE-INDEPENDENT (Atlas 2026-06-16 brief, phase 2; design-only, Atlas-owned). The load-bearing dedicated-reader / in-process pub/sub bus contract everything subscribes to: per-subscriber QoS (lossless sync/safety vs lossy display), bounded queues, producer-never-blocks, 100Hz-IMU-vs-~6/s-OBD rate handling, ECMLink/OBDLink K-line arbitration. F-110 shipped Slice 1 (bus skeleton + PersistenceSubscriber, ships-dark); this is the full contract + consolidation. Atlas open gate #1. Graduates the SSOT-bus direction into specs/ssot-design-pattern.md (gate #4) once CIO firms it. GROOM-READY candidate (design artifact; can run parallel to F-112).

features.title: EDR Phase 3 -- single-reader consolidation + IMU/light raw channels
features.description: HARDWARE-GATED (Atlas 2026-06-16 brief, phase 3). Consolidate all sources under ONE threaded reader publishing to the bus; add raw channels for the 9-DoF IMU (ICM-20948 @0x69) + light sensor (TSL2591 @0x29), both I2C on bus-1 (shared w/ X1209 UPS MAX17048 @0x36, no address collision). Needs the versioned src/common/ IMU raw table + schema under A-4 contract discipline (Atlas open gate #2 -- don't repeat the Pi<->server schema divergence). HARDWARE STATUS: sensors hardware-INSTALLED 2026-06-27 (ahead of the ~mid-July estimate); CIO mid-wire; hardware gate = i2cdetect shows 29/36/69 (NOT yet passed). Spec: docs/hardware-reference.md EDR-Sensors section + docs/edr-sensors-wiring-reference.md field card (dev 95d496a).

features.title: EDR Phase 4 -- event vault + on-Pi triggers + display surfaces
features.description: HARDWARE-GATED (Atlas 2026-06-16 brief, phase 4). High-rate local buffer -> rolling disk segments -> protected event vault, with on-Pi triggers that seal event segments on threshold breach (Spool threshold spec). Plus display surfaces (Iris) -- e.g. DELTA-2 live-instrument home card (compass/gear/grade/g-force from the 9-DoF IMU; parked under A-14, EDR-epic slice). Role 2 of the dual-role Pi (edge safety + event recorder; B-104 emitter role unchanged). Owners: Spool (triggers/thresholds) + Iris (display) + Atlas (vault schema, A-4). Downstream of F-112/F-113/F-114.

stories.title: Backfill 2 ECU lineage rows (supersede placeholder; close MD346675 era + open MD326328 era) + join verification
stories.goal: As a server-side analytics consumer wanting per-drive ECU attribution, I want the historical ECU lineage backfilled into vehicle_info as exactly two real eras -- prior ECU (MD346675) active before the ~2026-05-22 swap + new modified-EPROM ECU (MD326328) active from the swap onward -- SUPERSEDING the degenerate PRE_TRACKING_UNKNOWN bootstrap placeholder, so any drive's start_time_utc resolves to the active ECU at that time (and the stuck June-5 dtc_freeze_frame orphan self-heals). Per Atlas 2026-06-28 ruling: 2 rows (option a), NOT 3.
definitionOfDone: Supersede the degenerate PRE_TRACKING_UNKNOWN placeholder (zero-width install==removal==2026-05-01 11:53:45) -- it is a failed bootstrap, NOT lineage; do NOT retain it as a 3rd live row. Net post-backfill state = exactly 2 real ECU-era rows (Atlas ruling option a; a 3rd row would overlap the MD346675 window at the resolver's >1-window raise, sync.py:605)

FK target = ecu_id: the backfill calls resolveOrCreateEcu for BOTH ECUs (MD346675 + MD326328), sets vehicle_info.ecu_id, and DERIVES the TEXT ecu_signature/cal_signature snapshot columns from the resolved ecu rows so findEcuCoherenceViolations() returns empty (Atlas: resolver + coherence key on ecu_id; TEXT signatures are derived snapshots)

Boundaries form a gapless single-active partition: prior ECU (MD346675) install = start-of-tracking (earliest tracked capture / the existing bootstrap instant -> gapless partition start, NULL per Atlas), removal = swap instant; new ECU (MD326328) install = swap instant, removal = NULL (currently active)
Swap instant is Spool's to derive (last old-ECU drive-end / first new-ECU drive-start, ~2026-05-22) and is passed to the backfill as a script PARAM -- NOT hardcoded
Spool sign-off on signature naming convention recorded BEFORE backfill (per F-108 last bullet)
Placeholder provenance is recorded in the backfill script log + commit message -- NOT as a live lineage row

Bless the one-shot bootstrap/backfill script as the SOLE sanctioned exception to 'stamp_ecu_swap is the only vehicle_info mutator,' scoped to initial spine establishment (stamp_ecu_swap correctly refuses here -- placeholder closed -> getActiveVehicleInfo()==None; correcting a botched bootstrap is the backfill's job)

Data sources documented in commit body: prior-ECU start-of-tracking instant source (earliest realtime_data.captured_at or Eclipse 1998 Projects.gsheet -- approximate but documented); swap instant precise per Spool derivation
Join verification: drive_summary JOIN vehicle_info ON start_time_utc within [install, COALESCE(removal, NOW())] correctly partitions drives 1-24 (prior MD346675) + drives 25+ (new MD326328)
Coherence verification: findEcuCoherenceViolations() (vehicle_info_coherence.py) returns empty post-backfill; the resolver (sync.py:564-609) raises for NO drive (no >1-window overlap)
conditionalOutcomes: if Spool has not signed off on signature naming convention OR has not derived the swap instant, BLOCK the backfill + route an A2AL note to Spool
if join verification shows any drive 1-24 partitioning to the new ECU (or any drive 25+ to the prior ECU), revise + re-backfill
if the resolver raises a >1-window overlap for any drive post-backfill, the partition is not gapless-single-active -- fix the install/removal boundaries (do NOT introduce an artificial micro-gap)

stories.title: dtc_freeze_frame sync: quarantine unresolvable cross-tier rows after N failures (stop silent infinite retry)
stories.goal: As the sync subsystem, I want a single unresolvable freeze-frame to stop retrying forever (it ran 27x/day for 3+ weeks with no dead-letter/quarantine/alert -- a silent infinite loop that would mask a REAL sync failure in the noise). 'Fail loudly, no silent re-resolve' is correct per-attempt but wrong at the queue level. After N consecutive identical resolution failures, quarantine the record (dead-letter table OR data_quality flag -- Atlas quick-read requested) and surface it ONCE. General safety net; US-367 self-heals the current specific orphan.
definitionOfDone: Atlas invariant 1 -- after N consecutive identical cross-tier resolution failures on the same record, the sync loop quarantines it (dead-letter table or data_quality flag) and stops re-attempting every cycle
Atlas invariant 2 -- the raw freeze-frame record is PRESERVED (never dropped) when quarantined; quarantine throttles re-resolution, it does not discard data
Atlas invariant 3 -- the quarantine event is surfaced exactly once (log/alert), not per-cycle
Atlas invariant 4 -- quarantine is re-drainable (throttled/retryable, NOT terminal): once the resolution target exists (e.g. US-367 lands), the record re-enters the queue and syncs
a quarantined record does NOT advance sync_log.last_synced_id and does NOT block other tables/records from syncing
Typecheck passes; tests pass; a test proves N-failures -> quarantine -> single surfacing -> re-drain
